text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The United States strongly supports the territorial integrity and peaceful democratic development of the former Yugoslav republic of Macedonia, State Department spokesman says. U.S. administration does not support setting up of parallel structures urged by Albanians in Western Macedonia.
- Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski to call for vote of confidence in his government to start fighting organised crime.
- Opposition leader Ljupco Georgijevski says he has list of government officials connected to the TAT savings scandal.
- Students stop hunger strike but were not giving up their demands for revoking a law allowing use of Albanian language at the Pedagogical Academy.
- A shipment of 40 tonnes of flour from Debar leaves for Albanian town Peskopea on Friday.
